description: Every text change LexAPI observed on a document, newest first, with observedFrom (when the version began; absent if not recorded). These are LexAPI's fetch snapshots, NOT the law in force on a date (lex_legislation_as_of gives the version of an EU act for a date). History starts when the document entered the corpus. Cost: 1 credit.

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

name: lex_document_versions
title: Version history of a document
